title: 第25章 相煎何急
content_zh:
魏从善目不转瞬瞪着王万户，防他有甚异动，口中却在对厉氏兄弟说话：“二位厉兄，王主任今儿跟兄弟过不去，你二位可知其中缘由？”厉氏兄弟与他同府当差，虽然并不怎么交好，但魏从善手段圆滑，平日人缘甚好，若不是忌惮王万户武功了得，早已出言劝解。厉宏生接口说：“听王主任说，他也是受人之托，未必明白真相。只怕这中间有什么误会，也是有的。”

    魏从善冷笑一声说：“误会倒没有。兄弟跟着吴总前，是在惩教署做事的，这个你是知道的了？”厉宏生说：“是啊，你是肖署长推荐给吴总的。肖署长很是夸你精明能干呢。”魏从善说：“兄弟伤了这小姑娘的父亲，这件事是有的。兄弟一直好生过意不去。可是兄弟是奉了肖署长之命。你我同是吃公门饭的，主人家有差使交下来，你能违命么？”厉宏生这才明白，他借着与自己一问一答是在向王万户解说这回事的来龙去脉，便接上一句说：“这叫作奉命差遣，身不由己。那也怪不得魏兄弟你。”

    王万户在阿拜收到赵安全的血书，立即带着陈梦梅赶到邯郸，但没法找着赵安全，当下又到维京找人，一查之下，得悉魏从善已随同南下。他胯下所骑是王怡丹那匹烈焰马，不过两天已从维京追到武定来。魏从善如何害死陈安平父子，他确实不甚了解。陈梦梅年幼，说不明白，多问几句，她就眼眶一红，小嘴一扁，抽抽噎噎地哭个不停。这时听魏从善要言明此事根由，正中下怀，说道：“好，你曾说过，天下之事抬不过一个理字。你倒说说看。陈安平是你师叔，就算他犯了弥天大罪，也不能由你下手，置他于死地。”

    魏从善此时有恃无恐，料想今日已不难逃命，但王万户决不肯就此罢手，日后继续追寻，却难抵挡，心想总须说得他袖手不顾，方无后患，于是说：“王主任，你是忠厚仁善、光明磊落的英雄好汉。常言道：君子可欺以方。你这回可上了赵安全的大当啦。”王万户一愕，问道：“上了什么当？”魏从善说：“我们北宗太极门师祖传了三个徒弟，赵师伯为首，先父居次，陈师叔第三，他们师兄弟三人向来不睦，王主任你是明白的了？”王万户本来丝毫不知，但想自己插手管他门户之事，若说一切不知，未免于理有亏，当下不置可否，问道：“那便怎样？”

    魏从善说：“陈师叔是太极北宗响当当的好手，我对他老人家素来十分敬仰。他当法警教官，太极秘奥却半点不肯相传。肖署长生性好武，见他藏私，心中自是不快，连问了几次，陈师叔吃逼不过，竟辞职不干了。于是肖署长将在下找去，要我解释什么乱环诀、阴阳诀。可是先父武功本就平常，又逝世得早，没什么功夫传下来，在下懂得什么？肖署长便着落在下去向陈师叔请问明白。”

    王万户心想：“太极门南北两宗各有门规，本门武功秘奥不得传于公家。陈安平不授秘诀，此事大致不假。”便点了点头。魏从善脸色显得十分诚恳，说道：“在下奉了肖署长之命，与三位公门兄弟到陈师叔家里去。那时他身上有病，肝火大旺，三言两语就对我痛下辣手。王主任你想，以我这点稀松平常的武功，怎能害得了北宗太极门的第一好手？”王万户问：“那他是怎么死的？”魏从善说：“陈师叔本已有病，在下的言语又重了一些。陈师叔痰气上涌，失足摔了一跤，在下连忙施救，已然不及。”

    这番言语中破绽甚多，王万户正待驳斥，陈梦梅已叫了起来：“爸爸是他打死的！爸爸是他……”第二句话没说完，魏从善扼着她脖子的手一紧，将她后半句话制住了。王万户大怒，喝道：“你既说他有病，怎么又斗不过他？再说，他小儿子与你无怨无仇，又何以伤害无辜？快放手！”

    魏从善说：“王主任，你身在阿拜，怎知我门户中之事？我劝你还是各人自扫门前雪的好。”他一边说，一边移动身子，慢慢退向厅口。

    王万户双目如要喷火，只眼见此人心狠手辣，倘若上前拦阻，他定要伤害陈梦梅性命。这女孩年纪虽小，性格却极是坚毅，孤身一人，竟间关万里、历尽辛苦地寻到阿拜。以这条路上旅途之艰难，别说这样一个小小孤女，便壮年汉子也十分不易。王万户毅然插手管这件事，固为了赵安全斩手相托，有一小半也瞧在这孤女的孝心份上。后来与她共骑东来，时日一久，已视她如女儿一般。

    只见魏从善再退几步，便要出厅，王万户空有一身暗器，竟不敢向他发射一枚，心下盘算：“若用一枚最重的蛇头锥打他脑门，自能叫他立时丧命，但他临死之前只要手臂一送，小姑娘就性命不保。”

    只见他又退了一步，此时桌上一枚大红烛所结的一个灯花，突然卜的一声爆了开来，烛光一暗，待烛火再明，魏从善身旁忽已多了一个老者。

    那老者左手平举胸前，但光秃秃的只剩根腕骨，手掌已齐腕斩去，身穿青布长袍，形容枯槁，双目深陷，颧骨高耸，脸上灰扑扑的甚是怕人。魏从善见众人一起望着自己左侧，神情异样，不由回头一瞧。突见那人的左腕骨已伸到自己脸前，险些碰到，一惊之下，忙让开了一步，叫道：“赵……赵师伯，是你！”

    那人竟不理会，拉起长袍，抢上一步，向王万户磕下头去，说道：“王主任，你的恩情，赵安全只好来生补报了。”王万户急忙答礼，双眼却不离魏从善。魏从善急退两步，正要拥着陈梦梅抢出长窗，赵安全身形一晃，抢先堵住了去路，喝道：“回去！”魏从善问：“你让不让路？”赵安全说：“你已害过陈家两条命，姓赵的早就没想活着。”转向王万户说：“王主任，这位魏大爷的话在下在门外已听得清清楚楚，当真是一派胡言。我陈师弟是为了乱环诀与阴阳诀而死在这奸贼手下的。”

    王万户向魏从善侧目斜睨，哼了声说：“原来魏师傅精研我门的这两大秘诀，在下倒要领教。”赵安全说：“这倒不是。这位魏师傅知道我太极拳有九大秘诀，而乱环诀与阴阳诀又是拳法关键，只可惜他父亲过世得早，没来得及传他。他千方百计要我和陈师弟吐露，陈师弟知他心术不正，就没肯说。于是他用公家势力相压，陈师弟仍然不说。到后来他趁着陈师弟有病，夜中闯到陈师弟的病榻前，抓住他一脉单传的娃儿，说道若不吐露二诀，就将娃儿一剑杀了……姓魏的，我这话是真？还是假？”

    魏从善铁青着脸，一言不发，心中又惊又怒，眼见已可脱身，这老家伙偏偏在这时候闯了进来。只听赵安全哽咽着继续说：“一个聪明伶俐的娃儿便丧生在他利剑之下。陈师弟抱病与他拼命，又给他使云手功夫拖得精疲力尽，虚脱而死。王主任，赵安全愧为掌门，年老无能，我北宗又是人才凋零，眼下只有这姓魏的武功最强，只有老着脸皮，请南宗主持公道。”他转向魏从善说：“魏大爷，我的话没半句冤枉你吧？”

    王万户只听得义愤填膺，大步踏了上去说：“要学拳术的秘奥，自古以来只有求师访友，从来没听说过如你这等禽兽之行。”魏从善喝道：“你别动，给我站着！”说着手臂一紧，陈梦梅呀的一声叫了出来。王万户站定脚步，不敢再动。魏从善朗声说：“王万户，你要找我，尽管到警政署来。今日请你叫他让让道。”王万户无奈，只得向赵安全说：“赵师哥，今日咱们就暂且饶他！”

    赵安全大急，问道：“你说今儿……今儿饶……饶了他？”王万户说：“赵师哥，你放心，兄弟既拉扯上了这回子事，定然有始有终。”赵安全急得说不出话来，只说：“你……你……”王万户说：“让路给他吧。兄弟要是料理不了这回事，我斩这一只手还你！”这几句话说的斩钉截铁，赵安全再无话说，身子往旁一让，眼睁睁盯着魏从善，目光中充满了怨毒。

    魏从善心想：“今日我脱却此难，立时高飞远走，天下之大，何处不是容身之所？只要我隐姓埋名，你找一百年也找不着老子。”脸上不自禁露出一丝得意神色，说道：“王主任，你我后会有期。赵师伯说的不错，我确实想学一学太极门中乱环诀与阴阳诀的窍门。你上京来，晚辈要好好请你指点指点。”王万户哼了声，哪去理他。

    魏从善不敢转身，挟着陈梦梅一步步倒退，经过赵安全身侧，微微一笑，左足跨出了门槛。只须再走几步，便出厅门，黑暗中一躲，王万户再难找到自己了。
content_en:
Wei Congshan stared at Wang Wanhu for a moment, in case he did anything strange, but he was talking to the Li brothers: "Brothers Li, Director Wang is having trouble with his brother today, do you two know the reason?" The Li brothers were errands in the same house as him, and although they were not very good friends, Wei Congshan was smooth and well-connected. If he hadn't been afraid of Wang Wanhu's martial arts, he would have already spoken out to persuade him. Li Hongsheng said: "I heard from Director Wang that he was also entrusted by others and may not understand the truth. I'm afraid there are some misunderstandings, but there are some."

    Wei Congshan sneered and said: "There is no misunderstanding. Before I followed Mr. Wu, I worked in the Correctional Services Department. Do you know this?" Li Hongsheng said: "Yes, you were recommended to Mr. Wu by Director Xiao. Director Xiao praised you for being smart and capable." Wei Congshan said: "Brother hurt this little girl's father. This is true. Brother has always had a good life. I don't want to go. But brother, we are both on the official's side. I have an errand, can you disobey it?" Li Hongsheng then understood that he was explaining the whole story to Wang Wanhu by asking and answering questions, so he added, "This is called being sent by orders, and you can't help yourself. That's no wonder, brother Wei."

    Wang Wanhu received Zhao An'an's blood letter in Abai, and immediately rushed to Handan with Chen Mengmei, but could not find Zhao An'an. Then he went to Viking to look for someone. After checking, he learned that Wei Congshan had gone south with him. He was riding Wang Yidan's flaming horse, which he had chased from Viking to Wuding in just two days. He really didn't know much about how Wei Congshan killed Chen Anping and his son. Chen Mengmei was young and couldn't explain. If I asked a few more questions, her eyes would turn red, her mouth would flatten, and she would sob and cry non-stop. At this time, when Wei Congshan wanted to explain the reason for this matter, he got what he wanted and said, "Well, you once said that the affairs of the world cannot be explained by a single word. Please explain. Chen Anping is your uncle. Even if he has committed a heinous crime, you cannot let him die."

    Wei Congshan felt confident at this time and expected that it would be easy to escape today. However, Wang Wanhu refused to give up. He continued to pursue in the future, but it was difficult to resist. He thought that he would have to ignore it so that there would be no future trouble. So he said: "Director Wang, you are a loyal, kind and upright hero. As the saying goes: A gentleman can bully others. You have been fooled by Zhao An'an this time." Wang Wanhu was stunned and asked: " What have you been fooled by?" Wei Congshan said: "Our Beizong Taiji Sect master has three disciples, Uncle Zhao is the first, my father is the second, and Uncle Chen is the third. The three brothers have always been at odds. Director Wang, do you understand?" Wang Wanhu didn't know anything at first, but he wanted to intervene in his sect's affairs. It would be unfair to say that he didn't know anything. He immediately asked, "What about it?"

    Wei Congshan said: "Master Chen is a well-known expert in the Northern Tai Chi Sect. I have always admired him very much. He is a bailiff instructor, but he refuses to pass on the secrets of Tai Chi at all. Director Xiao is martial by nature. Seeing him hiding his secrets, he felt unhappy. He asked Master Chen several times if he wanted to be forced. However, he resigned. So Director Xiao went down to ask me to explain the Chaoshuan Jue and Yin Yang Jue. But my father’s martial arts were ordinary and he passed away early, so he didn’t have any skills. So what do you know about me? Director Xiao went down to ask Master Chen.”

    Wang Wanhu thought to himself: "The northern and southern sects of Taiji Sect each have their own sect rules, and the secrets of the sect's martial arts are not allowed to be passed on to the public. Chen Anping does not teach the secrets, so this is probably true." He nodded. Wei Congshan looked very sincere and said: "I followed the order of Director Xiao and went to Uncle Chen's house with three Gongmen brothers. At that time, he was sick and angry, and he attacked me with just a few words. Director Wang, think about it, with my ordinary martial arts, How could he harm the best master of the Beizong Taiji Sect?" Wang Wanhu asked, "How did he die?" Wei Congshan said, "Master Chen was already ill, and my words were serious. Master Chen's phlegm was rising, and he slipped and fell. I hurriedly tried to save him, but it was too late."

    There were many flaws in these words. Just as Wang Wanhu was about to refute, Chen Mengmei had already shouted: "He beat dad to death! Dad was him..." Before she could finish the second sentence, Wei Congshan tightened his grip on her neck, stopping the second half of her sentence. Wang Wanhu was furious and shouted: "Since you said he is sick, why can't you fight him? Besides, his youngest son has no grudge against you, so why would he hurt innocent people? Let go!"

    Wei Congshan said: "Director Wang, you are in Abai, how do you know what is going on in my door? I advise you to clean up the snow in front of your own door." As he said this, he moved his body and slowly retreated towards the entrance of the hall.

    Wang Wanhu's eyes were like spitting fire, he saw that this man was cruel and ruthless. If he stepped forward to stop her, he would definitely hurt Chen Mengmei's life. Although this girl is young, she has an extremely resolute character. She was alone, thousands of miles away, and went through all the hard work to find Abai. Given the difficulty of the journey on this road, let alone such a little orphan girl, it is also very difficult for a mature man. Wang Wanhu resolutely intervened in this matter. Although he cut off his hands for Zhao An'an, a small part of him also looked at the orphan girl's filial piety. Later, I rode east with her, and over time, I began to treat her like a daughter.

    I saw Wei Congshan taking a few steps back and about to leave the hall. Wang Wanhu had a hidden weapon, but he didn't dare to fire one at him. He thought to himself: "If I hit him on the head with the heaviest snake-head awl, he would be killed immediately, but if he just lifts his arm before he dies, the little girl's life will not be saved."

    I saw him take another step back. At this time, a lantern tied with a big red candle on the table suddenly exploded with a loud bang. The candle light dimmed. When the candle light came back on, there was an old man beside Wei Congshan.

    The old man raised his left hand flat in front of his chest, but only one wrist bone was left bare. The palm of his hand had been cut off to the wrist. He was wearing a green cloth robe and had a haggard appearance. His eyes were sunken, his cheekbones were high, and his face was gray and scary. Wei Congshan saw everyone looking at his left side with strange expressions and couldn't help but look back. Suddenly, he saw that the man's left wrist bone had stretched out in front of his face, almost touching him. He was startled and quickly took a step away, shouting: "Zhao...Uncle Zhao, it's you!"

    The man ignored him, pulled up his robe, took a step forward, kowtowed to Wang Wanhu, and said, "Director Wang, Zhao An'an will have to repay your kindness in the next life." Wang Wanhu responded hurriedly, but his eyes never left Wei Congshan. Wei Congshan hurriedly took two steps back and was about to grab Chen Mengmei out of the long window when Zhao An'an swayed and blocked the way first, shouting: "Go back!" Wei Congshan asked: "Are you going to give way?" Zhao An'an said: "You have killed two people in the Chen family. Zhao didn't want to be alive for a long time." He turned to Wang Wanhu and said, "Director Wang, I can hear what Uncle Wei said clearly outside the door. It is really nonsense. My junior brother Chen died at the hands of this traitor for the Chaos Ring Jue and Yin Yang Jue."

    Wang Wanhu glanced sideways at Wei Congshan and snorted: "It turns out that Master Wei has studied these two secrets of our sect carefully, and I want to learn from you." Zhao An'an said: "That's not true. This Master Wei knows that I have nine secrets of Tai Chi, and the Chaotic Ring Technique and the Yin and Yang Technique are the key to the boxing technique. It's a pity that his father passed away early and did not have time to teach him. He tried every means to get me. He told Junior Brother Chen that he knew he had evil intentions, so he refused to say anything. So he used public power to suppress him, but Junior Brother Chen still didn't say anything. Later, while Junior Brother Chen was sick, he rushed to Junior Brother Chen's bed at night and grabbed his baby, who was born in a single line. He said that if he didn't reveal the two secrets, he would kill her with a sword... Is this true or false? "

    Wei Congshan had a livid face and said nothing. He was frightened and angry. Seeing that he was about to escape, this old guy broke in at this moment. I heard Zhao An'an choked and continued: "A smart kid died under his sharp sword. Junior Brother Chen fell ill and fought hard with him, and he was exhausted with his Yun Shou skills and died of collapse. Director Wang, Zhao An'an is so ashamed. The leader is old and incompetent, and our Northern Sect is losing its talents. At present, only the martial artist surnamed Wei is the strongest, so I can only be shameless and ask the Southern Sect to seek justice." He turned to Wei Congshan and said, "Uncle Wei, have I not wronged you at all?"

    Wang Wanhu was filled with indignation and strode forward and said: "To learn the secret of boxing, since ancient times, the only way is to seek teachers and friends. I have never heard of animals like you doing this." Wei Congshan shouted: "Don't move, just stand here!" As he spoke, his arms tightened, and Chen Mengmei screamed. Wang Wanhu stood still and did not dare to move again. Wei Congshan said loudly: "Wang Wanhu, if you want to find me, just come to the police station. Please ask him to give way today." Wang Wanhu had no choice but to say to Zhao An'an: "Brother Zhao, let's spare him for today!"

    Zhao An'an was anxious and asked: "You said... let's spare him today?" Wang Wanhu said: "Brother Zhao, don't worry, since our brothers are involved in this matter, there will definitely be a beginning and an end." Zhao An'an was so anxious that he couldn't speak, so he only said: "You... you... ..." Wang Wanhu said: "Make way for him. If brother can't handle this, I will cut off my hand to pay you back!" These words were decisive. Zhao An'an was speechless and stepped aside, staring at Wei Congshan, his eyes full of hatred.

    Wei Congshan thought to himself: "Today I am freed from this difficulty, and I will fly away immediately. The world is so big, there is no place for me. As long as I remain anonymous, you will not be able to find me for a hundred years." He couldn't help but show a look of pride on his face, and said : "Director Wang, you and I will meet again later. Master Zhao is right. I really want to learn the tricks of Chaotic Ring Technique and Yin Yang Technique in Tai Chi Sect. When you come to the capital, I will ask you for your guidance." Wang Wanhu snorted and ignored him.

    Wei Congshan did not dare to turn around, and held Chen Mengmei in his arms step by step backwards. He passed by Zhao An'an, smiled slightly, and stepped out of the threshold with his left foot. He only had to walk a few more steps and then go out of the hall. Once he hid in the darkness, it would be difficult for Wang Wanhu to find him.
title_en: Chapter 25 Why worry about being fried?
